title: Word & Pic Solitaire
description: Flip, drag, and group mixed word and picture cards by shared topic into target category slots in a clever solitaire-style sorting puzzle.
controls: Drag matching word or picture cards onto their category cards or empty sorting slots; tap the deck to flip fresh cards.

zh-CN.title: 词图归类消消乐
zh-CN.description: 纸牌接龙 × 联想分类脑洞玩法：翻开桌面词卡与图卡，把同一主题的卡片成组归位收齐，越排越上头。
zh-CN.controls: 拖动同主题词卡或图卡叠放归类，将类别卡放进目标槽并凑齐全部子卡即可清空；点击牌堆可翻新牌。
